g.text: Round 16 | Annual results and probability diagnostics
Retained weeks by year: 22, 48, 50, 49, 46, 46. The 2015 sample is incomplete under the unchanged OHLC validity mask.
Probabilities are evaluated after fitting; observed frequencies and these diagnostics never alter the frozen models or decisions.
